AGREEMENT OF LIMITED PARTNERSHIP OF EXAMPLE VENTURES FUND I, L.P.

ARTICLE I

DEFINITIONS

"Management Fee" has the meaning set forth in Section 8.1.

1

ARTICLE VIII

Section 8.1 Management Fee. The Partnership shall pay the General Partner a management fee equal to two percent (2%) per annum of aggregate Commitments.

2

ARTICLE IX

Section 9.1 Carried Interest. Twenty percent (20%) of Net Profits shall be allocated to the General Partner.
